Module np.cincuentazo
Package np.cincuentazo.model

Class Card

java.lang.Object
np.cincuentazo.model.Card
public class Card extends Object
Represents a single playing card with a rank, suit, and face orientation.

    • hashCode

      public int hashCode()
      Two cards are equal if and only if they share the same suit and rank. Face-up state is intentionally excluded from equality because two cards with the same identity are the same card regardless of orientation.

      Note: in a standard deck there is exactly one card per (suit, rank) combination, so equality should rarely be triggered between distinct card objects in normal gameplay.

      Overrides:
      hashCode in class Object
